labels.退出纵向通风温度偏差值: Leave tunnel this far below tunnel temperature
labels.纵向通风时允许室外温度低于纵向通风开启温度最大值: Outside may be below tunnel temperature by at most
labels.最小/最大级别模式选择: How the floor and ceiling are set
labels.最小呼吸率对应室外低温: Outside temperature for minimum breathing rate
labels.最大呼吸率对应室外高温与加热开启温度温差: Outside high above heating temperature for maximum breathing rate
labels.启动偏差温度: Spray starts this far above target

explain.最小/最大级别模式选择: Where the lowest and highest steps come from: the age table, the age curve, or the birds' weight and breathing rate. Change it and the shed's fresh-air floor follows a different source from the next minute.
explain.当前日龄: The flock age the controller is counting. Every age-based curve looks up this number. It comes from the controller's own calendar and cannot be set here.
explain.当前体重: What the controller believes one bird weighs today, read off its weight curve. Used only when the floor and ceiling follow body weight.
explain.当前最小通风级别: The lowest step the shed can drop to tonight, however cool it gets. Lower and the night is stuffier and cheaper; higher and the air stays fresher at the cost of heat and power.
explain.当前最大通风级别: The highest step the shed may climb to today, however hot it gets. It caps how many fans can run at once.
explain.调速风机时控: Runs the variable-speed fan by the clock instead of by temperature. On, it cycles on a timer even when the shed is cool.
explain.精细降温曲线: Lets the controller move in smaller temperature steps between levels. On, the shed responds more smoothly; off, it steps.
explain.当前风机开启时间: How long the fans in a cycling step stay on in each cycle right now.
explain.级别温度偏差: How far above the target temperature the shed must be before this step engages. A small number brings the step in early; a larger one lets the shed run warmer before more fans start.
explain.级别开启时间: For fans set to cycle on this step, how many seconds they run in each cycle. Longer on-time means more air and more power at this step.
explain.级别关闭时间: For cycling fans on this step, how many seconds they rest in each cycle. Longer off-time means less air and less power.
explain.级别调速比例: How fast the variable-speed fan runs on this step, as a percentage of full speed. Fan power falls with the cube of speed, so a low percentage moves useful air very cheaply.
explain.级别风机: Whether this fan group is stopped, cycling, continuous or alternating on this step. Continuous gives the most air; cycling and alternating give about half the air for about half the power.
explain.级别小窗比例: How far the side inlets open on this step. Wider inlets slow the incoming air; narrower ones speed it up so it reaches the ceiling before it drops on the birds.
explain.级别幕帘比例: How far the tunnel curtain opens on this step. Opening it lets air enter along the length of the house for tunnel ventilation.
explain.级别幕帘2比例: How far the second tunnel curtain opens on this step.
explain.风机循环时间: The length of one on-and-off cycle for fans set to cycle, in seconds. Each step's on and off times are shares of this cycle.
explain.纵向通风开启级别: The step at which the controller switches from side ventilation to tunnel ventilation, pulling air the length of the house. A lower step brings tunnel mode in earlier, at more fan power.
explain.提高级别延时时间: How long the shed must stay above a step's temperature before the controller climbs to it. Shorter makes the shed react faster and hunt more; longer makes it steadier.
explain.降低级别延时时间: How long the shed must stay below a step's temperature before the controller drops from it. Longer keeps fans running a little past the point they are needed.
explain.退出纵向通风温度偏差值: How far below the tunnel temperature the shed must fall before tunnel mode ends. A larger number keeps tunnel running longer once it has started.
explain.纵向通风退出延时时间: How long the shed must stay below that point before tunnel mode ends, so a brief dip does not switch the fans back and forth.
explain.纵向通风时允许室外温度低于纵向通风开启温度最大值: If the outside air is colder than the tunnel temperature by more than this, tunnel mode is refused, so cold air is not pulled the length of the house onto the birds.
explain.冬季因子: Scales minimum ventilation down in winter, 1.0 being no reduction. Lower values keep more heat in at the cost of air quality.
explain.冬季室外温度: The outside temperature below which the winter factor applies.
explain.日龄: The flock age, in days, from which this row applies. Rows are read in order; each holds until the next row's age.
explain.最小级别: The lowest step the shed may drop to from this age, however cool it is. This is the fresh-air floor; lower is cheaper and stuffier.
explain.最大级别: The highest step the shed may climb to from this age, however hot it is.
explain.最小呼吸率: The least air the controller must move per kilo of bird at this age, as a breathing rate. It sets the minimum step when the floor follows body weight.
explain.最大呼吸率: The most air the controller will move per kilo of bird at this age. It sets the maximum step when the ceiling follows body weight.
explain.风机最小开启时间: The shortest a fan is allowed to run once started, so fans are not switched on and off within seconds.
explain.风机最小关闭时间: The shortest a fan is allowed to rest once stopped.
explain.最小呼吸率对应室外低温: The outside temperature at which the minimum breathing rate applies. Colder than this outside, the controller does not reduce air any further.
explain.最大呼吸率对应室外高温与加热开启温度温差: How far above the heating temperature the outside air must be for the maximum breathing rate to apply.
explain.呼吸率最小变化量: The smallest change in breathing rate the controller acts on, so tiny fluctuations do not move fans.
explain.低温报警温度: The house temperature below which the low-temperature alarm sounds from this age.
explain.加热温度: The house temperature below which the heaters start from this age. Set well below target where heating is not wanted.
explain.目标温度: The temperature the controller tries to hold from this age. Every ladder offset, the tunnel temperature, cooling and the alarms are measured from this number.
explain.纵向通风温度: The house temperature at which tunnel ventilation may start from this age. Usually a little above the target.
explain.高温报警温度: The house temperature above which the high-temperature alarm sounds from this age.
explain.目标温度修正: A correction added to the curve's target, plus or minus. Nudges the whole scheme without editing the curve, for example a night setback.
explain.目标温度带: The dead band around the target within which the controller does nothing. Wider means fewer step changes and a less steady temperature; narrower means more hunting.
explain.加热温度带: The band around the heating temperature over which the heaters ramp on and off.
explain.降温系数: How much moving air is counted as cooling, in percent. Higher means the controller trusts a breeze to make the birds feel cooler and holds back on more fans.
explain.快速降温限制: The most the controller will cool the house in one move, to stop a sudden chill after a hot spell.
explain.温度曲线选择: Whether the target follows the age curve. Off, the controller holds a fixed target.
explain.体重曲线日龄: The flock age, in days, at which this weight applies.
explain.体重: The expected weight of one bird at this age. Breathing-rate ventilation multiplies it by the flock to size the air it must move, so a wrong weight gives a wrong minimum.
explain.加热设定温度: The temperature below which heating starts, read from the temperature curve for the current age.
explain.加热模式: Whether the heaters are controlled as one house or by zone, each zone with its own offset.
explain.区域1偏差温度: How much warmer or cooler zone 1 is held than the heating set temperature.
explain.区域2偏差温度: How much warmer or cooler zone 2 is held than the heating set temperature.
explain.区域3偏差温度: How much warmer or cooler zone 3 is held than the heating set temperature.
explain.变频加热模式: Whether the heaters run at variable output rather than simply on and off.
explain.制冷开启时间: How long the pad pumps run in each cycle when cooling is on, in minutes.
explain.制冷关闭时间: How long the pad pumps rest in each cycle, in minutes. A longer rest lets the pad dry and uses less water.
explain.制冷启用时刻: The time of day from which the pads are allowed to run. Both times at 00:00 means all day.
explain.制冷停用时刻: The time of day after which the pads are not allowed to run.
explain.制冷温度: The house temperature at which the cooling pads start. In humid weather the pads cool little and raise humidity, so this is the setting that decides heat stress in monsoon.
explain.制冷模式: How cooling is paced: by fixed on and off times, by temperature, or adjusted automatically between the minimum and maximum duty.
explain.制冷周期: The length of one cooling cycle when the duty is adjusted automatically, in hours.
explain.最小比例: The least share of each cycle the pads run when the duty is automatic.
explain.最大比例: The most share of each cycle the pads run when the duty is automatic.
explain.制冷温差带: The band above the pad start temperature over which the duty ramps from minimum to maximum.
explain.当前制冷工作比例: The share of the cycle the pads are running right now.
explain.周期: The length of the cooling cycle in force right now.
explain.最小时间: The shortest the pads run in a cycle right now.
explain.最大时间: The longest the pads run in a cycle right now.
explain.每度温差时间: How much extra run time each degree above the pad start temperature adds right now.
explain.当前制冷时间: How long the pads have been running in the current cycle.
explain.灯光日龄: The flock age from which this lighting row applies. Onward holds it to the end of lay.
explain.灯光开启时间: The time the lights come on from this age. Day length drives lay in hens, so a change here shows in the egg count weeks later.
explain.灯光关闭时间: The time the lights go off from this age.
explain.灯光强度: How bright the lights are from this age, as a percentage of full.
explain.灯光延时: How long the lights take to ramp up or down at switching, so the birds are not startled.
explain.灯光曲线: Whether lighting follows the age table. Off, the lights keep their current times.
explain.喂料开启时间: The time the feed lines start for this window. Feeding at dawn and dusk keeps intake up in heat.
explain.喂料关闭时间: The time the feed lines stop for this window.
explain.风机风量: The rated airflow of this fan group, in thousands of cubic metres an hour. A calibration, not a control: the air quantity and air speed readouts, and breathing-rate ventilation, are only as true as this number.
explain.调速风机: The rated airflow of the variable-speed fan at full speed.
explain.风冷补偿日龄: The flock age from which this wind-chill factor applies.
explain.风冷系数: How much moving air is felt as cooling at this age. Chicks feel a draught as cold and hens as relief; a higher factor counts air speed as more cooling.
explain.湿度设定: The humidity the spray tries to hold. At 100% the spray never runs for humidity.
explain.喷雾湿度设定: The humidity below which the spray runs to add moisture.
explain.喷雾开启时间段: How long the spray runs in each burst.
explain.喷雾关闭时间段: How long the spray rests between bursts.
explain.喷雾控制模式: Independent runs the spray on its own humidity and temperature settings; linked runs it only together with the cooling pads and tunnel fans.
explain.湿度报警上限: The humidity above which the alarm sounds.
explain.湿度报警下限: The humidity below which the alarm sounds.
explain.启动偏差温度: How far above the target temperature the house must be before the spray starts as cooling.
explain.开启时间1: The time of day the first spray window opens. Both times at 00:00 means no window.
explain.结束时间1: The time of day the first spray window closes.
explain.开启时间2: The time of day the second spray window opens.
explain.结束时间2: The time of day the second spray window closes.
explain.小窗幕帘校准模式: Whether the inlets recalibrate their fully-open and fully-closed positions after a set time or after a number of moves.
explain.小窗幕帘切换次数: How many moves an inlet makes before it recalibrates, when calibration is by count.
explain.小窗幕帘校准次数: How many times an inlet recalibrates in a run.
explain.小窗幕帘提前动作时间: How many seconds before a step change the inlets begin to move, so the air path is ready when the fans change.
explain.单次校准指定时间: The time of day set aside for one calibration run, when calibration is by time.
explain.平均温度模式: On, every inlet follows the average house temperature; off, each inlet follows its own probes as set in Temperature definition.
explain.小窗角度: How far this inlet is open right now, in percent.
explain.幕帘角度: How far this tunnel curtain is open right now, in percent.
explain.小窗打开时间: How many seconds this inlet takes to travel from closed to fully open. A calibration: if it is wrong, 50% is not half open and the air jet lands on the birds.
explain.小窗关闭时间: How many seconds this inlet takes to close fully.
explain.小窗模式: Whether this inlet is in use. Off, the controller ignores it.
explain.小窗传感器: Whether this probe steers this inlet's zone.
explain.小窗温度偏差: How much warmer or cooler this inlet's zone is held than the house target.
explain.小窗调整因数: How strongly this inlet reacts to its zone being off target. Higher means bigger moves.
explain.小窗最小角度: The least this inlet is ever opened while in use, so a zone is never fully shut.
explain.负压控制选择: Whether the inlets are driven to hold a negative pressure rather than a fixed opening. On, the incoming jet is kept fast enough to reach the ceiling and mix before it drops on the birds.
explain.负压单位: The unit pressure is shown in: pascals or inches of water.
explain.舍外低温: The outside temperature at or below which the cold-weather pressure target applies.
explain.低温压力: The negative pressure held when it is cold outside. Higher pressure throws the cold jet further along the ceiling.
explain.舍外高温: The outside temperature at or above which the hot-weather pressure target applies.
explain.高温压力: The negative pressure held when it is hot outside. Lower pressure lets more air in for the same fans.
explain.开启关闭时间: How long the inlets move in one adjustment, in seconds.
explain.压力滞后: How far pressure may drift from target before the inlets move, so they are not forever adjusting.
explain.延迟时间: How long the controller waits between inlet adjustments.
explain.低压报警压力: The pressure below which the low-pressure alarm sounds. Low pressure usually means an open door or a stopped fan.
explain.压力连锁: Whether a pressure fault also stops or starts fans as an interlock.
explain.高压报警压力: The pressure above which the high-pressure alarm sounds. High pressure means the inlets are too closed for the fans running.
